rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved scientific seminars and meetings; any Board-approved national, state or regional meeting; online CE and webinars must be RACE-approved or Board-approved
rules.new_licensee_rule: Recent graduates credentialed in year 1 of the triennium: 20 h; year 2: 10 h; year 3: exempt for the first renewal.
rules.carryover: Hours over 30 may carry over to the next triennium, max 10 hours.
rules.alternatives: Board may waive CE for qualifying military service personnel or spouses.
rules.notes: Triennium runs Jan 1 - Dec 31 of the third year (current 1/1/2024-12/31/2026). Max 15 h distance education, max 10 h practice management, max 15 h graduate courses per triennium.
rules.rule_quote: 8.8(1) In order to renew a certificate of registration, each credentialed veterinary technician completes, triennially, at least 30 hours of continuing education in courses approved by the board.
